amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Expense amount as a plain number in Indian Rupees (e.g. 450 for 'Rs. 450 ka lunch' or '450 rupees ka bill tha'). Extract only the numeric value.

category.title: Category
category.description: Expense category. Must be exactly one of: Meal, Travel, Accommodation, Samples, CME / Event, Other. Infer from context: 'lunch' or 'dinner' = Meal; 'cab' or 'auto' or 'petrol' = Travel; 'hotel' = Accommodation; 'samples' = Samples.

hospitalName.title: Hospital or Facility Name
hospitalName.description: Hospital or clinic name (e.g. 'HCG Bangalore'). Helps find the correct visit report when multiple visits exist today.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Free-text description of the expense (e.g. 'Lunch with Dr. Reddy at HCG Bangalore canteen').

physicianName.title: Physician Name
physicianName.description: Name of the physician this expense is associated with (e.g. 'Dr. Reddy'). Used to automatically find today's visit report.

visitDate.title: Visit Date (defaults to today)
visitDate.description: Date of the visit in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today if not provided.
